name: The Deep Dunes
summary: The southern sand-sea: dunes that shift like slow animals, still places between them where nothing moves, and the buried eye of Akhmat somewhere beneath. The Dhar Roads cross it by memory and cairn; everyone else crosses it lost.

geography.character: tall shifting dune-seas, hardpan pans, silence-hollows between the crests

notable_sites.name: The Deep Dune Cairn
notable_sites.note: The southern route-marker of the salt roads' deep branch; travelers add a stone and a name.

notable_sites.name: The Buried Eye
notable_sites.note: Hollowborn teaching holds that Akhmat watches from under the sands; the still places are said to be where the gaze rests heaviest.

lore_notes: 'No sea in the desert — but the desert has its own tide'; old dune-folk claim the sands move in a slow year-cycle anyone can read who survives one full turn.
Storm-Bound exiles speak of walking the deep dunes as penance; the Roads give them water and pretend not to know why.
adventure_hooks: A caravan's tracks are found continuing over a dune that was not there when they camped.
Players escort an empty flask across the deep dunes — sealed, unopened, wanted at the far edge within nine days.
